title: Mixed factorization comparison for locally closed extensions
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring, X a Noetherian scheme, i : S ⟶ T a closed immersion, v : T ⟶ X an open immersion, and a : S ⟶ X an immersion with i ≫ v = a. Then the closed-then-open extension lowerStar Λ i ⋙ openImmersionLowerShriek Λ v is naturally isomorphic to extension by zero into the scheme-theoretic image openImmersionLowerShriek Λ a.toImage followed by lowerStar Λ a.imageι.

source.place: localization and successive quotient clauses of det-lem-coefficient-heart-filtration

proof.text: Reconstruct the section-ring sheaf for each scheme. The uniquely normalized cartesian coefficient isomorphism has direct-image adjunct equal on each section to condensedPushforwardHom. By uniqueness this is the coefficient map used by InternalModuleOperations. Therefore the two actual sectionwise direct-image functors agree; uniqueness of left adjoints compares their inverse images and open extensions.

The abstract composite-adjunction identity expresses the adjunct of the composite coefficient identification as the composite of the two adjuncts followed by the site pullback-pasting comparison. Evaluate that identity on sections. The composition law condensedPushforwardHom_comp identifies it with the adjunct for the composite scheme morphism. Uniqueness of spCoefficientIso then proves equality of the coefficient identifications, hence equality of the bundled composite coefficient immersions.

All immersion sources, including the scheme-theoretic image, are Noetherian. Obtain a normalized locally closed extension system from locallyClosedExtensionCoherence. Its closedOpenFactorization and openClosedFactorization, together with equality of the composite coefficient immersions from hfac and a.toImage_imageι, compare the closed-then-open and open-then-closed composites on section modules. Whisker with the fixed section-module equivalences and the previously proved direct-image and open-extension comparisons, then cancel the fully faithful target equivalence. This gives the displayed natural isomorphism, including for empty sources and zero modules.

proof_origin.place: Proved coefficient-adjunct composition, normalized factorization comparison, and transport through section-module equivalences.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientHeart_filtration_core {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : S ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] (v : T ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion v]
    (a : S ⟶ X) (ha : IsImmersion a) (hfac : i ≫ v = a) :
    letI : IsImmersion a := ha
    letI : TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace S := a.isEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
    Nonempty (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ i ⋙ CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ v ≅
      CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ a.toImage ⋙
        CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ a.imageι)
